findings.claim: On the Q1 2026 earnings call, Camtek management said the company's goal has been, and it has been highly successful in achieving it, to maintain leadership in 3D bump metrology market share while continuing to gain additional share in the 2D inspection market.
findings.source: Camtek Ltd. (CAMT) Q1 2026 Earnings Call transcript (Gurufocus/Seeking Alpha), tied to Camtek Q1 2026 results press release (PR Newswire)

findings.claim: Onto Innovation announced its Dragonfly G5 inspection platform was qualified for a range of 2.5D advanced-packaging applications and passed TSMC's New Tool Selection Committee qualification process, with initial deliveries slated for June 2026 — a competitor design win at TSMC in the same advanced-packaging inspection/metrology space Camtek serves.
findings.source: Onto Innovation press release, "Onto Innovation's Dragonfly G5 System Qualified for Applications in 2.5D AI Packaging" (via Morningstar/Business Wire)
